title: When the Vehicle Is Stuck: Noticing It Without Crying Wolf, a Ladder of Things to Try Per Vehicle, and Knowing When to Give Up

questions.question: What are the two halves of the stuck test?
options: Commanded to move for a whole window, and moved less than a distance
questions.explanation: A stopped vehicle is not stuck.

questions.question: A vehicle commanded to stop for 10 s was flagged how many times?
questions.explanation: It was not trying to move.

questions.question: The snagged vehicle finished in 23.5 s on which attempt?
options: At the first attempt, by waiting
After 2 attempts, the second by backing up
questions.explanation: The wait did not help; the back up did.

questions.question: The wall that never moved was given up on after how many attempts?
Why does a car's ladder back up twice instead of spinning?
options: A car cannot spin in place
questions.explanation: Leave out the rungs a vehicle cannot do.

questions.question: Why does every behaviour have a time limit?
options: A back up that is itself blocked would reverse for ever
